headlines.title: Shopify (SHOP) Is Up 7.3% After Analysts Spotlight Its Expanding AI Commerce Infrastructure Role
headlines.summary: In recent weeks, Shopify has attracted renewed attention as analysts highlighted its accelerating revenue and profit growth, expanding payments footprint, and AI-powered commerce tools, including integrations that let third-party agents complete purchases via Shop Pay across its merchant base.

headlines.title: Is Shopify Stock a Buy After Its First Record Close in Nearly a Year?
headlines.summary: The e-commerce stock is back at last year's record close, but the business behind it is around a third bigger. Is that enough?

headlines.title: Shopify (SHOP) Falls More Steeply Than Broader Market: What Investors Need to Know

headlines.title: MercadoLibre vs. Shopify: Which Consumer Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
headlines.summary: MercadoLibre trades at a fraction of Shopify's valuation despite comparable growth, but regional exposure and fintech leverage create vastly different risk profiles.

headlines.title: Algolia Launches Native Shopify B2B Integration, Bringing Account-Specific Search & Discovery to Wholesale & Retail
headlines.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, October 13, 2026--Algolia, the Retrieval Intelligence platform that helps ecommerce teams turn every search into a sale, today announced native support for Shopify B2B. Retailers, brands, wholesalers and distributors selling to business buyers on Shopify can now deliver search & product discovery that adapts to each customer, from the products and prices they see to how results are ranked, so buyers find the right items faster, reorder with less effort and spend more.

description: Shopify Inc., a commerce technology company, provides tools to start, scale, market, and run a business of various sizes in Canada, the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and Latin America. The Company offers Shopify platform that enables merchants to manage products and inventory, process orders and payments, fulfill and ship orders, build customer relationships, source products, leverage analytics, and reporting and access financing for running their business across all of their sales channels, including web and mobile storefronts, physical retail locations, social media storefronts, and marketplaces. It also provides Shopify Payments, a fully integrated payment processing service that allows merchants to accept and process payment cards online and offline. In addition, the company engages in the sale of themes and apps; shipping labels through Shopify Shipping; point-of-sale hardware; advertising on the Shopify App Store; and Shop Campaigns for buyer acquisitions, as well as registration of domain names. The company was formerly known as Jaded Pixel Technologies Inc. and changed its name to Shopify Inc. in November 2011. Shopify Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Ottawa, Canada.
